01 · Who we are

A small studio with a big, self-built audience

Naolito is a 2D animation and illustration studio based in Málaga, Spain, created by illustrator, animator and filmmaker Nacho Arjona. Since 2009 it has been building The Cute Side of Life: a universe of food, animals, planets and everyday objects living small, relatable moments.

The audience came first. Around 1.2 million people follow Naolito across social networks, and its designs have sold organically on 14+ platforms worldwide and in independent shops in Spain, Belgium, France and Italy.

We are not a global megabrand, and we do not pretend to be. We are a small studio with a proven, organic audience, a deep catalogue of finished artwork and an in-house animation team. We are looking for an agency to turn that demand into structured licensing programmes.

02 · Characters

Meet the cast of The Cute Side of Life

A recurring cast of foods, animals and planets with simple shapes, big eyes and one clear emotion each. They are easy to read at any size, from a pin to a duvet cover.

The Avocado family

Parents and their baby pit. Kindest Surprise is Naolito's best-known design, and the family has a whole storyline (babycado, tired avocado).

Broccoli

The lonely vegetable nobody likes. One of the most famous Naolito characters and the star of the animated short Nobody likes me! (5.5M views on TikTok).

Sun, Cloud & baby Rainbow

A tender sky family. A natural fit for baby, family and Mother's and Father's Day products.

T-Rex

A dinosaur who never quite wins. Asteroid, Paper, Scissors is one of the series' classics.

The Sushi gang

Salmon, tofu and nigiri in love stories and sporting feats (Sushi is Love, Sushi Olympics).

Blue, the Earth

A curious planet who explores the world. With Saturn, the Sun and the Moon, Blue already appears in 2D and in 3D shorts.

Before & After

A series of characters before and after coffee, the gym or the shower. It sells as stickers, sweatshirts, prints and the Nesquik mugs.

Wallet

A responsible little wallet, worried about the future and other adult stuff. A Naolito Originals character, animated in 3D.

Character names are descriptive: the series has no official roster. [TO COMPLETE: official character names and short bios, if we define them for the style guide]

03 · The universe

A catalogue of hundreds of finished designs

The Cute Side of Life has 12+ years of illustrations about everyday life: Mondays, coffee, the gym, summer heat, family and love. Most work with little or no text. Every image is original Naolito art, owned by the studio and ready to adapt.

07 · Audience and markets

Who buys Naolito, and where

Humour that needs no translation: the characters work without text, and the few short captions already exist in English and Spanish.

Who it is for

Our read (not yet measured): adults and young adults who share relatable humour online, people buying gifts, food and animal lovers, and families who like the avocado and rainbow families.

  • Self-purchase: T-shirts, stickers, mugs and wall art
  • Gifting: birthdays, Mother's and Father's Day, Secret Santa
  • Kids and family: soft, positive characters
  • [TO COMPLETE: age, gender and country breakdown from insights and sales]

Where we sell

  • Spain and Latin America: our home market, with a Spanish-language book from Planeta and Spanish press and TV. Latin America is reachable through Spanish-language content. [TO COMPLETE: share of audience in Latin America]
  • Europe: past stockists in Spain, Italy, France and Belgium, DesignPlace today, and EU platforms such as Displate
  • United States: English-language social media and US platforms such as Threadless and TeePublic. [TO COMPLETE: share of sales in the US]

Why it travels

  • Visual gags with little or no text
  • Universal subjects: food, animals, weather, planets
  • Evergreen jokes that do not depend on trends
  • Built-in seasonal hooks: Mondays, summer heat, gym season, family days
  • Native to social media: every launch can come with animated content

08 · Opportunities

Product categories where we see potential

Based on what already sells on our platforms and with partners, plus a few next steps that suit the characters.

Apparel and sleepwear

T-shirts are our top seller on every platform (73 of 120 cards in our Redbubble shop). Next steps: pyjamas, kidswear, socks and loungewear.

Wall art and home décor

122 metal posters on Displate, 46 canvases on iCanvas, and prints at DesignPlace. Also cushions, blankets and tapestries.

Mugs, tableware and kitchen

The Nesquik mug collection and best-selling mugs and coasters. Food characters fit kitchen, lunch boxes and bottles.

Stationery and back-to-school

Notebooks already sell on our platforms, and we have done brand work with Pilot. Also agendas, pencil cases and calendars.

Stickers, pins and small gifts

Stickers and enamel pins are steady sellers. Impulse-buy formats for design and gift shops.

Plush and collectibles

Simple, round characters with one clear emotion. Not produced yet: a natural next step for toy partners.

Greeting cards and gift wrap

Family, love and seasonal gags (Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, birthdays).

Publishing

Our first book came out with Lunwerg / Planeta in 2021. Next: picture books, activity books and gift books.

Promotions and food and beverage

Nesquik showed the fit: food characters for packaging, gift-with-purchase and in-store campaigns, with animation made by our own studio.

09 · The partnership

What we are looking for in an agency

A medium-sized or boutique licensing agency that will actively build a programme for The Cute Side of Life, with clear targets from the start.

Territories

  • Spain and Latin America
  • Europe
  • United States
  • We are open to one agency covering several territories or to separate agents per territory. Exclusivity by territory and category to be agreed.

Categories

  • Priority: apparel, wall art and home décor, mugs and giftware, stationery and back-to-school
  • Growth: toys and plush, publishing and greeting cards, food and beverage promotions
  • Digital and animation rights stay with Naolito unless agreed otherwise

Term and minimum results

  • Initial term of 2 or 3 years
  • Minimum targets per year: [TO COMPLETE: minimum number of signed licensees] and [TO COMPLETE: minimum guaranteed royalty income]
  • Review at 12 months, with the right to end the agreement or narrow its scope if the minimums are not met
  • Quarterly reporting on pipeline, signed deals and royalties

What we bring

  • Hundreds of finished designs: 266 on Threadless, 156 on Redbubble, 122 on Displate
  • An in-house studio for new art, adaptations and launch animations
  • About 1.2M followers to support licensee launches
